title: AI hater "content creator" issue
author: No_Astronomer_379
selftext:
Hey Guys, 

I've released a game recently which is AI assisted, about 8 months of work went into it: I carefully selected voices, design, changed them several times, on the Steam page it is disclosed. Obviously I didn't expect much, but I sent out to press and content creator emails to get some coverage. 

This is when things totally went sideways and not just because there are video creators with AI hate but there are so called journalists as well who wrote a review which was literally about AI use and the game is so bad because it used AI voices and visuals. Just a side note: several normal non-ai-hater journalists gave 8/10. But this article is literally about the AI hate. I didn't really wanted to care as I looked up the guy and he barely has any followers orvisitors, but the next step  made me really angry: he started to link and promote his so called review to my audience. Posted it as a review on the Steam reviews, posted on X tagging us, Facebook posts and comments, literally everywhere. 

So now it doesn't matter that we have 4-5 press articles with positove feedback those are invisible as they didn't add effort to post them to any other platforms, so everywhere I look now is the hater's content which is coming to my face and he use this to get his pages promoted. 

Most of his reviews are negative btw for several games he just added worst AI slop and other nonsense usual hater content. I normally avoid these and never start to argue but as I see this in more and more places I decided to ask you guys if anyone faced with the same issue before and what you did against it?

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Your post was automatically removed because it looks like it's mainly about anti-AI attitudes elsewhere, without discussing game development using AI. This sub is focused on game development using generative AI (Rule 1).

A mod will review this removal and can restore the post if it was a mistake. You don't need to do anything, but you can [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev) if you want to add context.
